# lab-secrets

Every store and secret the lab holds, folded into what `cata` reads, plus the step that proves they open.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| step | [LAB_STEPS](../signatures/LAB_STEPS.md) | Plan steps a floe contributes, keyed by step name. |

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| labSecrets | catallaxy.labSecrets | Every secret the lab holds, keyed by the name the CLI knows it as. |
| labStores | catallaxy.labStores | Every store the lab reads authored secret values from, keyed by the name the CLI knows it as. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `every-floe` as the lab unit `secrets`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.

| kind | entries |
| --- | --- |
| catallaxy.labSecrets | externaldns-tsig, vault-credential |
| catallaxy.labStores | authored, knot, runtime |
